summary: Iteration 3: tested the backend and frontend for boosts, item cards, pickups, rotators, death/respawn and the one-screen game layout. Backend: 50 pytest tests (29 existing + 21 new in test_robostrike_iter3.py), 49 pass. Passing: board extras (rotators and pickups on all 3 boards), sandbox/new items [], turbo,turbo,right (5,1)N -> (8,1) dir 0, turbo+forward moves 2, turbo+laser ignored, item cards without inventory ignored, bomb with items (3 dmg, range 3, not at 4, removed from items), double_laser item, pickups (bomb added to items, life sets hp 5, 'taken' holds the id, a pickup is only taken once per turn and is back next turn), rotators +1/-1 in the board phase, falling and laser deaths (dead=true/alive=false, no later actions, final 'respawn' frame at spawn with hp 5, invuln true, lives-1), invuln blocks damage then resets, elimination after 3 turns. One failure: an item card placed right after a boost is ignored but still removed from the inventory. Frontend (admin): no site header on /sandbox; the toolbar test IDs work; sandbox-exit goes to /home (header comes back). At 1920x950 and 1600x900 there is no page scroll and the board, plates, console and resolve button are all visible. Cards: Avancer/Reculer/Boost/Gauche/Droite/Laser/Blast plus Double tir/Bombe/Bouclier with count 0 and disabled; no U-turn card. After Boost, laser and blast are disabled; badges ×4 / ×3 / ×2 are correct; 20 random programs were all valid. A 3-robot UI scenario passed: R1/R3 kill each other in S5 and KO shows on their plates, the R2 strafe picks up double_laser and its lightning icon shows in robot-items-1, a respawn frame closes the turn (25/25), new turn gives 'Tour: 2', and R2's Double tir card shows count 1 and goes back to 0 (disabled) after use. Mobile 390x844: tray-left/right scroll (0 -> 198 -> 0) and the flows work, BUT the page overflows horizontally by 52px (scrollWidth 442) because the toolbar's right group does not wrap. No console errors.

minor.issue: An item card (bomb/double_laser/shield) placed right after a turbo is ignored, but it is still taken from stock and from robot.items, so the item is lost. The stock.remove/used.append runs before the boost check sets a=None. The UI blocks this combination today, but the server should not lose the item.

If the existing admin's password differs from ADMIN_PASSWORD, it is rehashed and overwritten. The playbook says the seed should never change an existing admin's password. There is also no brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow: document scrollWidth is 442 on a 390 viewport. The right group (board-select, robots-select, sandbox-reset, lang-toggle-game) is `flex ml-auto` with no wrap, and the board select's long name 'Arène Ouverte / Open Arena' pushes sandbox-reset and lang-toggle-game partly or fully off screen.

issues: The item card heads are truncated ('Double t...'), and the 0-count badge is hard to read on the greyed cards.

action_items: In compile_program, check the boost rule before taking an item from stock, so an item card placed after a boost stays in the inventory
Fix the mobile toolbar overflow: add flex-wrap/min-w-0 to the right-hand group and/or set max-width or w-full on board-select below the sm breakpoint
Optional: show the full item card labels or shorten them; seed_admin should not overwrite an existing admin's password
critical_code_review_comments: game_engine.compile_program: the item is consumed before the boost check sets it to None (see minor backend issue).
Board lasers fire in every slot's board phase (up to 6 damage per turn for a robot standing in column 4/5 on the arena). It is consistent, but check this is the intended balance.
A robot that ends a move in a hole is only marked dead in the 'resolve' phase, so during that slot's board phase it can still be hit by board lasers and block conveyors.
GameCanvas.jsx is 695 lines, at the 700-line split threshold.
Sandbox.jsx: resolve() and startSandbox() still have no try/catch or loading guard (carried over from iteration 2).
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI scenario for KO/items: 3 robots on arena, R1 laser x6, R3 laser x6 (they face each other on row 0 and die in S5), R2 turbo,turbo,turbo,right,turbo,forward strafes north onto the (9,3) conveyor and then moves W onto double_laser (7,2). Arena board lasers in columns 4/5 hit robots every slot, so avoid them in tests. test_robostrike_iter3.py::TestBoost::test_turbo_bomb_does_not_consume_item is expected to fail until the compile_program fix.
